sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Reprogrammed keycard for A.P.'s apartment lock (Blue) (A.P. Blue) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A blue TerraGroup Labs keycard reprogrammed using technical data from A.P.'s flash drive. In theory it might open a hidden room in A.P.'s apartment.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.
- This keycard does not open any lock.
